# Vendored front-end libraries

Committed so KubeLite works offline with no Node.js toolchain.

| File | Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alpine.esm.js` | [alpinejs](https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine) (`dist/module.esm.js`) | 3.17.5 | MIT |
| `xterm.js`, `xterm.css` | [@xterm/xterm](https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js) | 6.0.0 | MIT (`LICENSE-xterm`) |
| `addon-fit.js` | [@xterm/addon-fit](https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js) | 0.11.0 | MIT (`LICENSE-xterm-addon-fit`) |

To upgrade, download the package tarball from `https://registry.npmjs.org/<package>/-/<name>-<version>.tgz` and replace the files above.
